interpretation: Research acceptance targets, not a forecast or promised investment return.
scope: market-only reproducible factors; no unavailable point-in-time financial or industry data

evaluation_policy.primary_market_reference: CSI All Share 000985; unchanged price-open-to-close timing
evaluation_policy.total_return_series: H00985; strategy and index both first-day close to final-day close
evaluation_policy.pool_reference: same eligible pool, schedule, execution, costs and risk-exposure policy; a shared new timing overlay must be applied to both sides and original full-investment references also retained
evaluation_policy.returns: arithmetic mean of independent 30-trading-day windows; no annualization or stitching
evaluation_policy.risk: no leverage; marked residual holdings remain in NAV; risk thresholds are acceptance tests, not guaranteed stop-loss caps
evaluation_policy.changed_rules: report independently; freeze a limited candidate suite before examining its returns
evaluation_policy.development_only: all existing 14 windows are viewed; passing them does not establish out-of-sample success
evaluation_policy.out_of_sample: freeze chosen rules before unseen chronological or forward paper validation; report the same metrics without fitting validation data
evaluation_policy.validation_metric_targets: same +0.5pp mean index excess, +0.3pp same-pool excess, -15% return/drawdown floors, 20bps and aligned total-return nonnegative gates; absolute strategy mean return is not fixed to the old market period
evaluation_policy.validation_strength: Six disjoint windows provide a preliminary gate only; require longer monitoring and data quality audit before production replacement.
evaluation_policy.failure_policy: report unmet targets; do not relabel viewed windows or relax thresholds retrospectively
